note: Large ASD sequencing cohorts show NAV3 variants are exceptionally rare (<0.5%) while dedicated cohorts report distinct syndromic features like microcephaly, ID, and dysmorphisms.

evidence.text: In a massive study integrating de novo and inherited variants across 42,607 autism cases, NAV3 was characterized as a moderate-risk gene with only rare partial or whole gene mutations, confirming an extremely low yield in unselected ASD cohorts.

source.title: Integrating de novo and inherited variants in 42,607 autism cases identifies mutations in new moderate-risk genes
source.quote: For both ITSN1 and NAV3, we identified four partial or whole … among NAV3 heterozygotes is similar to the SPARK cohort

evidence.text: Pathogenic NAV3 variants cause a distinct syndromic neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by intellectual disability, microcephaly, skeletal deformities, ocular anomalies, and behavioral issues.

source.title: Variants of NAV3, a neuronal morphogenesis protein, cause intellectual disability, developmental delay, and microcephaly
source.quote: We report eleven individuals from seven families harboring predicted pathogenic biallelic, de novo, and heterozygous variants in the NAV3 gene... All affected individuals have intellectual disability (ID), microcephaly, skeletal deformities, ocular anomalies, and behavioral issues.
